extraction.Name: Christina Mesteth
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want the patent in fee to her 160 acre allotment, when it was issued, but was informed by the Pine Ridge Agency, that taxes would be assessed against it, for which it would finally be sold, if she did not take it over, so she accepted the patent
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: mortgaged her allotment to John C. Jordan, of Gordan, Nebraska, for $250.00; mortgage subsequently cancelled on the sixth day of April, 1921
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to John C. Jordan, of Gordan, Nebraska, for $250.00 at 10% interest, to be paid by January 1, 1924; mortgage cancelled April 6, 1921
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: in 1925, she got notice from Rapid City, South Dakota, that her land would be sold for taxes, if she did not pay them; her husband told them to sell it, for he did not have the money to pay the taxes
extraction.Occupation/Income: husband farms some land of his own, and occasionally works for other farmers, these being the only sources of his income
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent, has very poor health; husband has good health and supports her and her six minor children, four of whom have good health and two having poor health — one suffering from the effects of pneumonia and the other has the eczema; they find it pretty close living off of this income for such a big family; has never received any aid from the County, State nor the United States Government; affidavit sworn December 3, 1928; County of Shannon, State of South Dakota | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Pine Ridge Agency" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')

recovery_notes.rationale: Pine Ridge tribe field had 40+ string variants across the corpus. Consolidating to canonical 'Pine Ridge' for clean tabulation while preserving original variant in NOTES for audit.
